newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: HANGIL IN 33-FOR-100 RIGHTS OFFER.
newsitem.headline: HANGIL IN 33-FOR-100 RIGHTS OFFER.

text.p: Hangil Merchant Banking Corp said on Tuesday it plans to offer a 33-for-100 rights issue in October to raise operating funds.
Hangil will issue 2.03 million new common shares with 20 percent offered to Hangil employees, a company statement said. The rest will be allocated to its shareholders as of September 19.
Subscription is set for October 20 and 21, with payment due by November 3. The rights issue will be made at a 25 percent discount to a base issue price to be announced at a later date.
With the rights issue offer, the company's paid-in capital would rise to 35 billion won from 24.8 billion, a company official said.
Hangil shares closed unchanged at 10,000 won on Tuesday.
